exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-06-13 to 2026-06-19): growthbook.io had 16,308 sessions and 11,435 users (+29.2% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 16,308 sessions (+29.2% WoW) | 11,435 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,464 clicks (+2.1% WoW) | 195,166 impressions (+28.1% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 8,669 GA4 sessions (-2.5% WoW) all-traffic | 1,935 GSC clicks (+3.2% WoW) organic | 14,410 GSC impressions (+3.0% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 1,142 GA4 sessions (-11.7% WoW) all-traffic | 97 GSC clicks (-8.5% WoW) organic | 6,074 GSC impressions (+13.0% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,403 GA4 sessions (-0.8% WoW) all-traffic | 1,100 GSC clicks (+3.3% WoW) organic | 129,699 GSC impressions (+6.8% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 9,918 GA4 sessions (+97.0% WoW) all-traffic | 332 GSC clicks (+3.8% WoW) organic | 132,998 GSC impressions (+32.1% WoW)
- All-other-pages GA4 sessions nearly doubled (+97%) while GSC organic clicks rose only +3.8% — the strongest AI-search-displacement signal in the account this week. Pricing all-traffic down -11.7% while impressions are up +13.0% — worth watching next week.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely** continues its coordinated AI experimentation campaign ("Powering AI With Feature Flags," "AI Experimentation Takes With Elena Verna," "Big Ideas In AI Driven Experimentation" — all Tier 1, third consecutive week flagged). Also refreshed or republished its **Experimentation** and **Feature Management** product pages. GrowthBook's **/blog/a-b-testing-in-the-age-of-ai** is still declining; no counter-content published.
- **Harness** published four Tier 1 posts this week: **"Feature Flag Driven Development"** (KD 7), **"Node.js Feature Flags"** (KD 0), **"AI-Powered Feature Management with Harness MCP Server and Claude Code"**, and **"Make Data-Driven Decisions with Warehouse-Native Experimentation"** — the last two directly overlap GrowthBook's AI + warehouse-native experimentation positioning. Harness is building content depth in both spaces simultaneously.
- **LaunchDarkly** published **"Feature Flags AWS DevOps Agent"** (Tier 1) — targets the developer/DevOps ICP at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and feature flags. LD's "Git Branching Strategies vs. Trunk-Based Development" also surged +589% ETV this week (absolute ETV 1,600), reclaiming a keyword cluster GrowthBook could contest.
- **PostHog** CUPED and LLM Prompt Experiments docs continue to appear — fifth consecutive week, still no GrowthBook counter-content published.
- ⚠️ No new pages detected from **Statsig** or **Unleash** this week — likely a monitoring gap, not a content pause.

**New GrowthBook content**
- **/insights/statsig-alternatives** and **/insights/free-ab-testing-tools** — noticed this week via sitemap (real publish dates unknown). Both are zero-impression so far. "Statsig alternatives" is well-timed: **/blog/how-to-migrate-from-statsig-to-growthbook** (published 2026-04-02) is already at position 7.2 with 11 clicks/week; internal links between these two pages now will accelerate indexing.
- **/insights/95-confidence-interval** (KD 24) and **/insights/free-product-analytics-tools** (KD 35) — also noticed this week, zero impressions. Both are higher-KD plays; promote via internal links now to build equity early.
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** (published 2026-05-18): jumped to 94 clicks this week (up from 52 last week, +81%) and 23,129 impressions at position 8.6 — the strongest-performing new page in the account. This surge is real signal; the page is breaking out.

**Strategic priorities (ACP)**
- **Top-10 footprint is now 167 keywords (+69 over 3 months)** — trajectory is accelerating (was +56 three months ago at 154).
- **Comparison page BOFU fix remains the single highest-ROI task in the account.** Seven act-now pages have cleared the persistence gate. Priority order this week:
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly** (ACP 82, pos 10.3, AI Overview present, GrowthBook cited) — structural upgrade converts existing AI authority into signups.
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-statsig** (ACP 82, pos 7.6, AI Overview present, GrowthBook cited) — same.
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-posthog** (ACP 80, pos 6.5, 4,103 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook cited) — highest impression volume of the three; new this week to the top tier.
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-optimizely** (ACP 80, pos 9.5, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited) — still 0 clicks this week despite 2,115 impressions/28d.
- **"what is a/b testing"** (ACP 70, pos 11.83, 901 impressions, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited, 1,900 monthly searches) — add an answer capsule H2 to the targeting page this week.

**Organic movers worth watching**
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared**: 94 clicks (+81% WoW), 23,129 impressions, position 8.6 — material acceleration from last week's 52 clicks. Internal links and social push warranted now.
- **/insights/matched-pairs-design-explained**: 15 clicks (up from 3) — new mover, high-authority stats content, same audience as PostHog's CUPED docs. Add internal links.
- **/blog/a-practitioners-guide-to-treatment-effects**: 3 clicks (down from 10) — reversed direction after two weeks of growth. Still worth an internal link push given PostHog's CUPED competition.
- **/insights/best-ab-testing-tools-product-analytics**: 2 clicks (down from 14) — sharp single-week reversal; monitor next week before acting.
- **/compare/growthbook-vs-posthog**: 3 clicks this week (up from 1), 4,103 impressions/28d at position 6.5 — best-positioned comparison page by rank; structural upgrade is the lever.

**Recommended actions**
- **Apply the answer-capsule + comparison table + schema fix to **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly**, **/compare/growthbook-vs-statsig**, and **/compare/growthbook-vs-posthog** this week** (ACP 82, 82, 80). All three have AI Overviews where GrowthBook IS cited — the structural upgrade is the conversion layer. **/compare/growthbook-vs-posthog** is new to this priority tier and has the highest impression volume (4,103/28d).
- **Apply the same fix to **/compare/growthbook-vs-optimizely** this week** (ACP 80, pos 9.5, 2,115 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited). Still 0 clicks; one afternoon of work.
- **Add internal links from **/blog/how-to-migrate-from-statsig-to-growthbook** to the newly detected **/insights/statsig-alternatives** immediately** — the migration post is already at position 7.2 and can pass link equity to the alternatives page before it indexes.
- **Promote **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** via social this week** — 94 clicks at position 8.6 is breaking out; a social push can accelerate backlink acquisition and push it into the top 5.
